name: quote-invert
description: 金句反转拍：ink 实块擦入 → 反白金句（两色纪律的强调镜）
css: #tpl-quote-invert { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); overflow: hidden; } .qi-block { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; } .qi-text { position: absolute; left: 8vw; right: 8vw; top: 34vh; font-size: 6.4vh; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); opacity: 0; } .qi-author { position: absolute; left: 8vw; bottom: 10vh; font-size: 2vh; color: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); opacity: .7; }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .qi-block", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.inOut" }, {start} + 0.2);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .qi-text", { opacity: 0, y: 30 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.72);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .qi-author", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.4 }, {start} + 1.05);
